name: OKCubing 2016

venue.name: Wiley Post Event Center
venue.address: 2021 S Robinson Ave Oklahoma City, OK 73109
venue.details: Across the park from Robinson. Follow the road around the playground, and take a left at the first intersection.

information: Registration for this event will be $25 and $5 more if you chose to do 7x7. This is to help cover the cost of the venue and other necessities for the competition. $1 per competitor will go to the WCA.
